## Automated Tests Required

### MMS-007 Keybindings & Input Remapping — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/main_menu/keybindings_test.go` (**exists — 24 tests, currently FAILING**; implementation must be fixed so they pass; add cases only for uncovered ACs)
**What to test**:
- AC-1 capture: click slot → next key binds to primary; Escape cancels without change
- AC-2 conflict auto-unbind: stolen key → old action "Unbound" with icon + amber text; no key maps to two actions; cascade stops at one hop
- AC-3 modifiers: Ctrl/Shift/Alt stored as `{key, modifiers}` bitmask; modifier-only press keeps capture active
- AC-4 restore: per-row and Restore All; per-row needs no confirmation, all-defaults does
- AC-5/AC-6 reserved keys (Escape/F9): warning with override; last-binding block
- AC-8 persistence: round-trip through `settings.cfg`; missing/corrupt file → defaults, other categories unaffected
**Edge cases to cover**: non-printable keys (F5) bound as key code; rebind to same-action secondary slot = no conflict; left/right modifier treated as same flag
**Estimated test count**: ~24 (existing) + fill any AC gaps

### DIALOGUE-UI-001 Dialogue Panel Framework — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/dialogue_ui/panel_framework_test.go` (headless; visual parts → manual)
**What to test**:
- AC-4 state machine: Hidden → Active → Processing → Response order; input enabled only in Active/Response; typewriter completion re-enables input
- AC-2 input routing: Esc or X click → transition to Hidden/exploration
- AC-5 scaling logic: height-based scale computation at 1280×720 yields ≥12px effective body text (assert scale factor math, not pixels)
**Edge cases to cover**: Esc during Processing (input disabled — no double-dismiss); conversation start while panel already Active (no duplicate panels)
*No formulas exist in dialogue-ui.md (ABSENT) — state-transition cases derived from ACs directly. Visual ACs 1/2/3/5 animation/rendering parts are covered by the manual checklist below.*
**Estimated test count**: ~10

### PWS-005 World Evolution Rules — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/persistent_world_state/evolution_rules_test.go`
**What to test** (ADR-0013 + GDD formulas):
- AC-1: `IF world.ruin_cleared AND days_since(world.ruin_cleared_at) > 7 THEN location_repopulated` fires and submits exactly one WorldEvent
- AC-2: declaration-order evaluation; single pass — earlier rules never re-fire
- AC-3: circular dependency (later rule writes flag an earlier rule read) → warning logged; self-loop flagged
- AC-4: rule targeting destroyed entity → skipped + warning; remaining rules continue
- AC-5: YAML parse — valid schema populates RuleSet; invalid syntax/missing field → parse error with line number
**Edge cases to cover** (from GDD Edge Cases): exactly 7 days → strict `>` does NOT fire; flag unset → `days_since` returns 0, no fire; negative elapsed (time travel) → no fire; empty rules list is valid
**Estimated test count**: ~12

### PWS-006 Save/Load Integration & Performance — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/persistent_world_state/save_load_test.go` + Go benchmarks (same package)
**What to test**:
- AC-1 round-trip: 100 entities / 500 flags / 2000 log entries → all flags (name/type/value) and entries (event_id, type, timestamp, actor, target, region, details, protected) restored
- AC-2 migration: v1→v2 rename migration runs before restore; unknown flags skipped + logged; chained multi-version jumps; migration panic → load fails with error
- AC-3 evolution re-evaluation on load: 490 elapsed days → `days_since > 7` rule fires, event submitted; zero/negative elapsed → no fire
- AC-4 destroyed-entity logs: preserved and queryable; `destroyed_with_clues` flag persists
- AC-5 PERF (Go `testing.B`): `SubmitWorldEvent` p95 ≤ 0.5ms (5 mutations, 50 entries); `GetWorldFlags` p95 ≤ 0.1ms
**Edge cases to cover**: empty save; entity at 32-flag max; log at 50-entry cap boundary
**Estimated test count**: ~14 tests + 2 benchmarks

### PARTY-001 Party Roster & Active Slots — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/party/roster_test.go`
**What to test**:
- AC-1: remove/swap on PC ID rejected in every party state (PC slot locked)
- AC-2: add at capacity (config `vs_party_size`=4 / `full_vision_party_size`=6 — never hardcoded) → rejected with full-roster result; member goes to pool
- AC-3/AC-4: recruited companion in active slots + `pc_controlled` tag; pool members untagged
- AC-5: pool relocates to new rest point (CR-1)
**Edge cases to cover** (from GDD Edge Cases): solo party (size 1) is valid; double-remove idempotent; removed member's GameEntityID not reused
**Estimated test count**: ~8

### PARTY-002 Companion State Machine — Logic ⛔ (blocked on ADR-0016 acceptance)
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/party/state_machine_test.go`
**What to test**:
- AC-1: exactly one of `Unrecruited`/`InParty`/`InPool`/`Departed`; `Departed.cause` ∈ {trust_betrayal, story, death, dismissed} survives save/load
- AC-2/AC-3: departure trigger during combat/conversation → deferred until end; companion behaves normally meanwhile
- AC-4: `cause: death` → re-recruitment transitions permanently blocked
- AC-5/AC-6: dismissal (with confirmation) and story triggers → `Departed` with correct cause
**Edge cases to cover** (GDD): death takes precedence over trust betrayal in same combat; pool-member death via world event; illegal transition (e.g. `InPool → Departed` with no cause) rejected
**Estimated test count**: ~12

### PARTY-003 Recruitment via Trust & Dialogue — Integration ⛔ (depends on PARTY-002)
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/party/recruitment_test.go`
**What to test**:
- AC-1: trust 2 / threshold 2 / slot free → active slots + `pc_controlled` + next-encounter roster + formation follow
- AC-2: sufficient trust / roster full → pool only, not in formation
- AC-3: trust below threshold → rejected, no state change
- AC-4: story condition unmet → deferred, condition tracked in recruitment data, surfaced via dialogue
- AC-5: recruitment must not reset trust (stays 2)
**Edge cases to cover**: tier-configured capacity check; double-recruit idempotent; recruitment during combat/conversation rejected (Story 013 gating)
**Estimated test count**: ~10

### PARTY-007 Combat Roster Integration — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/party/combat_roster_test.go`
**What to test**:
- AC-1/AC-2/AC-3: recruit/swap-out/swap-in reflected in the *next* encounter roster
- AC-4: mid-encounter roster change does not alter the live encounter snapshot
- AC-5: roster exposed only via read-only `ActiveRoster()` — no consumer mutation path
**Edge cases to cover**: solo roster (PC only) → combat proceeds; PC always first in order; pool members never in roster
**Estimated test count**: ~9

### ASSET-001 FBX Import & Normalization — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/asset_pipeline/fbx_normalization_test.go` (path proposed — story file declares none)
**What to test**:
- Import: FBX → Kaiju native mesh with correct vertex data (verify against `kaiju/src/rendering/` per engine notes)
- Scale: both-pack doors normalize to 1u = 1m (2u door reference; within 10% of each other)
- Orientation: Z-up source → Y-up in engine (assert transform math)
- BLEND → FBX export stage runs first
- Non-PoT texture (1500×900) → padded to 2048×1024 + warning logged
**Edge cases to cover** (GDD): unmapped material → default grey + warning (never guessed — control manifest); conflicting pack scales → both flagged, human decides; missing asset ID in scene → error marker
**Estimated test count**: ~8 (fixture FBX files required — small synthetic fixtures, not full KitBash3D packs)

### AUDIO-002 Ambient Soundscapes — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/audio/ambient_soundscapes_test.go` (mock audio backend; gain/position asserted, not sound)
**What to test**:
- AC-1: Dawn→Day crossfade — both sources ramp over 5s; at t=2.5s both ≈0.5 gain; mid-crossfade transition aborts and restarts from current gains
- AC-2: five distinct soundscapes, one per light state; game start at 08:00 → Day begins immediately, no crossfade
- AC-3: duration configurable per transition pair; 0/negative → instant switch
- AC-4: clock pause (combat/conversation/menus — ADR-0007) → playback pauses and resumes from recorded position; light state changed while frozen → crossfade on resume; stacked pauses record position once
- AC-5: region layers blend additively (2s fade), cap 3 concurrent, no gain pops on rapid enter/exit
**Edge cases to cover**: *audio-system.md has no Edge Cases section (ABSENT) — inferred from story ACs only*
**Estimated test count**: ~12

### COMBAT-006 Combat Resolution Integration — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/combat/resolution_test.go`
**What to test** (ADR-0009/0007/0011):
- AC-1/AC-2: all enemies dead → `CombatEnded{VICTORY, xp}`; all party dead → `CombatEnded{DEFEAT}`
- AC-3: game clock paused at 14:30 resumes from 14:30
- AC-4: XP split — 3 survivors, 300 XP → 100 each via AwardXP
- AC-5: events fire synchronously (control manifest: death recorded BEFORE trust events), clock resumes, camera returns to Exploration
**Edge cases to cover** (GDD): PC knockout is always defeat/game-over; enemy fleeing → combat ends, enemy neutral; environmental kill credits environment (no XP); initiative tie → higher DEX then higher entity ID
**Estimated test count**: ~10

## Manual QA Checklist

### MMS-007 — Integration (UI secondary)
**Verification method**: Manual step-through | **Sign-off**: ux-designer + accessibility-specialist
**Evidence**: screenshots of capture mode + warning dialogs to `production/qa/evidence/`
- [ ] Gamepad preset dropdown shows Default/Southpaw/Left-Handed; selection applies immediately and persists across restart
- [ ] Capture mode visually distinct: amber-gold pulsing highlight + "Press a key..." prompt; Escape cancels cleanly
- [ ] Conflict warning shows icon + amber text (two cues — accessibility requirement)
- [ ] Screen reader (AccessKit) announces capture state and binding changes

### DIALOGUE-UI-001 — Integration (UI/Visual secondary)
**Verification method**: Screenshot + interaction walkthrough | **Sign-off**: ux-designer
**Evidence**: before/after screenshots at 1920×1080 and 1280×720
- [ ] Panel slides up over ~300ms ease-out (no bounce), occupies lower third, world above fully visible and undimmed, unfurl sound plays
- [ ] Esc/X closes: ~200ms slide-down, roll sound, exploration controls restored
- [ ] Top bar shows NPC portrait + name + X button; no amber-on-parchment body text (amber accents only)
- [ ] Input visibly disabled during Processing, re-enabled after typewriter completes
- [ ] At 1280×720: all elements visible, ≥12px effective text, no overflow/clipping
*Animation timing ACs (300ms/200ms) are subjective — the headless tests assert state transitions; frame-accurate timing verification happens here with screenshots + manual timing.*

### ASSET-001 — Integration (Visual secondary)
**Verification method**: In-editor visual check | **Sign-off**: art-director / technical-artist
**Evidence**: screenshots of imported doors from both packs
- [ ] Both-pack doors render ~2 world units tall (within 10%)
- [ ] Imported assets upright (Y-up), not sideways
- [ ] Unmapped material renders default grey with logged warning
- [ ] PoT padding warning appears for 1500×900 texture import

### AUDIO-002 — Integration (Visual/Feel secondary)
**Verification method**: Listening check | **Sign-off**: sound-designer / audio-director
**Evidence**: session notes (what was heard, when) to `production/qa/evidence/`
- [ ] Dawn→Day crossfade is smooth over ~5s — no pops or silence gaps
- [ ] All five light states have distinct, continuous ambience
- [ ] Ambient pauses during combat/pause menu and resumes seamlessly at the same position
- [ ] Region layer (river/wind) blends in and out without gain pops

### COMBAT-006 — Integration
**Verification method**: In-game walkthrough | **Sign-off**: gameplay-programmer
- [ ] After victory: clock visibly resumes (NPC schedules move), camera returns to exploration framing, no UI state leaks
- [ ] After defeat: game-over flow triggers correctly

## Smoke Test Scope
Critical paths to verify before any QA hand-off for this sprint:
1. Game launches to main menu without crash
2. New game / new session can be started
3. **Keybindings regression**: Settings → Controls opens; rebind one key; restart; binding persists
4. **Dialogue panel regression**: panel opens on NPC interaction, closes on Esc, world stays live
5. **Combat loop**: combat starts and ends; clock resumes; camera returns (COMBAT-006)
6. Save/load cycle completes without data loss; world flags restored (PWS-006)
7. Performance within budget — no new frame spikes (PWS-006 benchmarks + ambient crossfades)

*Smoke tests are verified by the developer via `/smoke-check`. Reference this list when running that skill.*

## Definition of Done — This Sprint
A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:
- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence (screenshot, video, or playtest notes with sign-off)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for all Visual/Feel and UI stories
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] No regressions introduced
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review` or documented peer review)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)
